question: Who may issue, approve and hold a financial mandate, and what is the rule where fewer than three eligible people exist?
decision: Three distinct authorized people for issuing, approving and holding high-impact financial mandates wherever the union constitution requires. A small-local exception needs two independent tenant office-holders plus a separately authorized trustee or parent-body counterparty, documented constitutional basis, time limit, enhanced audit and periodic review; no self-approval. No platform staff member substitutes for a union fiduciary.
originalProposedDecision: Three distinct people by default (source today). A small local with fewer than three eligible people may use a governed exception: two people plus a parent-body or trustee countersignature, recorded.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
